text: {"label":"Extinction Processes and Extinction Bursts","definition":"Basic and applied research on extinction itself: extinction bursts, resistance to extinction, response loss during operant and Pavlovian extinction, extinction cues and reminders, and how prior reinforcement conditions shape extinction effects.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centers on extinction as the process studied, unlike alternative-reinforcement treatments for problem behavior, avoidance and aversive-control research, or conditioning studies in nontraditional species."}
